name: Local Volume Orientation Estimation
definition: A heuristic method to compute the orientation (rotation matrix) of a local volume centered at point $i$ using its two closest neighbors $j$ and $k$ at a specific time step. This ensures equivariance: if the points are rotated by matrix $R$, the resulting orientation matrix rotates by $R$ as well.
summary: Local Volume Orientation Estimation is a heuristic method that computes a local rotation matrix using cross products of nearest neighbors, offering a computationally lighter alternative to SVD-based approaches.
